metadata.title: Counterexamples and symmetry for uneven orthogonal mass partitions in the plane
metadata.abstract: Grünbaum asked whether every planar convex body admits, for every $0\leq t\leq 1/4$, two orthogonal lines cutting it into pieces with cyclically ordered areas $t,t,1/2-t,1/2-t$. Bárány posed the analogous question for well-behaved planar measures and conjectured that the answer there is negative. We confirm Bárány's conjecture in a particularly robust form: for every fixed $0<t<1/4$ we construct smooth, strictly positive, centrally symmetric, strongly log-concave measures arbitrarily close to the standard Gaussian for which the prescribed partition does not exist. In contrast, we prove that the partition exists for every $t$ whenever the measure is invariant under an orientation-reversing affine involution. We also exhibit a $96$-point counterexample for which no pair of perpendicular lines produces cyclic counts $8,8,40,40$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对任意固定 0<t<1/4 构造任意接近标准高斯的光滑正、中心对称且强对数凹测度，否定指定不均匀正交四等分；另给对称条件下的正面结论及离散反例。
techniques: 仿射反向 involution 对称
analysis.breakthrough: 确认 Bárány 的负面猜想，并显示强正则性也不能消除障碍。
analysis.limitations: 反例针对测度问题；不能据此声称 Grünbaum 原始凸体面积问题已全部解决。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露在项目中持续与 ChatGPT（GPT-5.6 Sol）协作，用于数学探索、证明策略发展与精炼、初稿和计算；最终证明、计算与参考文献由作者核查并负责。

analysis.priorityReason: 反例强且适用条件精细，但偏凸与离散几何，不是本组最高相关方向。
